privileged_info_for_vlm: The presentation must be created in ONLYOFFICE. Required text strings for validation: 'Dr. Chen', 'Troponin I', 'NT-proBNP', 'ST elevation', and 'apical ballooning'. The final file must be saved as 'grand_rounds_takotsubo.pptx' in /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/. The presentation must contain exactly or at least 6 slides and include 2 specific images (ecg_admission.jpg and lv_angiogram.jpg).
